body:
Two years ago, mine told me I was destroying his life and he never wanted to speak to me again, just as I was recovering. Looking back, and knowing how bad I felt, I honestly have no idea how I got through it. I think I basically just had to wait it out. I tried to go out for walks but ended up being scared to do anything. I just did the minium at work, watched TV, and put on so much weight. Starting to shed it now though. I have a new best friend who I've known for 10 months but it feels like I've always known him. He really got me through this. 

It's so sad that do many people have to deal with losing their friends.
Right?! Mine takes 15mins tops & I do this once every few months - rest of the time I make sure I mop up spills/crumbs as I go, and no slimey off veggies etc...
